from datetime import datetime

need = {
 'F2Z01_t': 'baef86cb-2941-5d61-87b0-ffa91d79f23a',
 'F2Z01_coolsp': '1213f3a8-c23d-55b5-8187-4712d49a82ae',
 'F3Z01_t': 'e0dd5f44-f050-5faa-a2a0-a3fcb6284ae8',

 'F4Z01_coolsp': '22de734e-0a64-57ec-a6a5-f288ee06f947',
}
data = {k: {} for k in need}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        tid = r['timeseries_id']
        for k,v in need.items():
            if v == tid:
                data[k][r['timestamp']] = float(r['value'])

def window(vald, ba, occ):
    out=[]
    for ts,v in vald.items():
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
        if dt.year != 2018: continue
        if ba=='before' and not (dt.month < 6 or (dt.month==6 and dt.day<=15)): continue
        if ba=='after' and not (dt.month>6 or (dt.month==6 and 15<dt.day<=30)): continue
        wk = (dt.weekday()<5 and 8<=dt.hour<=17)
        if wk==occ:
            out.append(v)
    return out

for k in need:
    bo = window(data[k],'before',True); ao=window(data[k],'after',True)
    bu = window(data[k],'before',False); au=window(data[k],'after',False)
    d1 = sum(ao)/len(ao)-sum(bo)/len(bo)
    d2 = sum(au)/len(au)-sum(bu)/len(bu)
    print("%-15s occ B/A: %7.2f -> %7.2f (d %+.2f)   unocc B/A: %7.2f -> %7.2f (d %+.2f)" % (k, sum(bo)/len(bo), sum(ao)/len(ao), d1, sum(bu)/len(bu), sum(au)/len(au), d2))

A zone-specific level shift (in all hours) is a local override/controller offset, not a schedule change (which would alter the time structure).
